WITH team_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        l.name AS league,
        t.team_long_name AS winning_team
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Team t ON m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
    WHERE m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        l.name AS league,
        t.team_long_name AS winning_team
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Team t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
    WHERE m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal
),
win_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        league,
        winning_team,
        COUNT(*) AS total_wins
    FROM team_wins
    GROUP BY league, winning_team
),
all_teams AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.name AS league, t.team_long_name
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Team t ON m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
    
    UNION
    
    SELECT DISTINCT l.name AS league, t.team_long_name
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Team t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
),
team_wins_all AS (
    SELECT 
        all_teams.league,
        all_teams.team_long_name,
        COALESCE(win_counts.total_wins, 0) AS total_wins
    FROM all_teams
    LEFT JOIN win_counts ON all_teams.league = win_counts.league AND all_teams.team_long_name = win_counts.winning_team
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        league,
        team_long_name,
        total_wins,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY league ORDER BY total_wins ASC, team_long_name ASC) AS rn
    FROM team_wins_all
)
SELECT league, team_long_name, total_wins
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY league;
